🎮 Overview: What is the Hugo SMP Changelog Plugin?
The Hugo SMP Changelog Plugin is a streamlined, server-side Minecraft plugin designed to bridge the gap between server development and the player community. Inspired by the automated and polished update systems used on popular content creator servers like Hugo SMP, this plugin allows server administrators to log, categorize, and publish server updates directly from the in-game chat or via Discord.
The Core Philosophy
 Effortless for Admins: No need to touch configuration files, restart the server, or copy-paste text into Discord. Updates are handled entirely via simple commands.
 Engaging for Players: Keeps the community informed and excited about new features, bug fixes, and balancing changes without requiring them to leave the game.
🛠 Key Features & In-Game Mechanics
1. The Dynamic ⁠/changelog⁠ GUI
When a player types ⁠/changelog⁠ in-game, an interactive chest inventory interface opens up:
 Chronological Timeline: Every major server update is represented as an item (e.g., a Book & Quill or a Map). The latest update is always placed in the top-left slot.
 Color-Coded Categories: Clicking on a specific update reveals its details, beautifully organized using colored blocks or custom items:
 🟢 Lime Wool / Emerald: Features – New content, plugins, or mechanics added to the server.
 🔴 Red Wool / Redstone: Fixes – Patches for bugs, exploits, or performance issues.
 🟡 Yellow Wool / Gold: Balancing – Tweaks to economy prices, mob spawn rates, or drop chances.
